newsitem.title: USA: Search Financial changes MS deal.
newsitem.headline: Search Financial changes MS deal.

text.p: Search Financial Services Inc and MS Financial Inc said Tuesday they modified an agreement for Search Financial to buy MS Financial.
Under the modified merger agreement, MS Financial holders will receive $1.63 in Search common stock, subject to a minimum of 0.28 and a maximum of 0.37 shares of Search for each MS Financial share.

The original pact provided for price adjustments based on changes in MS Financial's stockholders' equity and its delinquency and loss experience subsequent to Dec. 31, 1996 through shortly before closing.
The price adjustment provisions of the original merger agreement have been deleted. There are approximately 10.4 million MS Financial shares outstanding.
The company said that due to unavoidable regulatory delays, it now expects the merger to close promptly following receipt of stockholder approval in late July.
After the merger is completed, Search estimates it will have about $170 to $180 million in gross receivables under management and a net worth of about $33 to $35 million.
As of March 31, 1997, Search had $62.3 million in gross receivables and a net worth of $25.7 million.
